Telemetry-off spans <1k/job and FactKey hash/clone/eq 108/64/47 are NOT the cost; interning the key measured -0.1%.
Probe (spike_r5.diff): diff-based replace_held: -1.2..-1.5% (15.238G vs 15.43G, n=3 interleaved), byte-identical, distill pins unchanged.
Candidates: diff-based held reads; share one read set across contribution derivations; incremental finality counts; pop-concluded scan proportional to change; single-lookup slot entry. readers_of semantic sort (~0.8%) waits for fz-t93.8 (determinism decision).
Paper first: short proposal page with predictions; then build. Bar: measured instruction delta reported; no pin rises without approval.
title: A recorded read costs the World what it costs the engine
